_comment: Template for --mapping arg to scripts/ingest_lb_permits.py. Copy to lb_permits_mapping.json and replace the right-hand-side values with the ACTUAL field names from the LB Socrata dataset. View raw fields with: curl '<dataset-url>?$limit=1' | jq 'keys'. Truth-first: if LB's dataset does not include APN (some jurisdictions don't), leave 'ain' OUT of the mapping; permits will be written with NULL apn, and permit_matcher will return source='unavailable' for those — NOT False.
